notes.title: Common Card Trading Week!
notes.content:
[h1]🃏 Common Card Trading Week is Here! 🃏[/h1]

[i]Calling all collectors and traders![/i]
From [b]May 10th at 17:00 CEST[/b] to [b]May 17th at 17:00 CEST[/b], you’ll be able to trade all common cards freely with anyone in the community!

[h2]🤝 Trade Without Limits[/h2]
No restrictions, no barriers—just pure trading fun!
Whether you want to grow your collection, help a friend, or clean up your duplicates, this is your chance to make the most of your collection.

[h2]🌍 Time Zones[/h2]
[b]Starts:[/b] May 10th at 17:00 CEST
(08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 23:00 CST / [i]00:00 JST – May 11[/i])

[h3]💬 Don't forget:[/h3]
You can find trading partners in our official [u][url=https://discord.gg/kbhTfzqzQT]Discord channel[/url][/u] (linked in-game). It’s the best place to connect, trade, and chat!

⏳ [b]You have 7 full days[/b] to make your trades — use them wisely!
